say:1:1035241001:0.text: We can't live inside this old, worn-out tent any longer...
say:1:1035241001:0.source_cn: 这帐篷都这么破了，哪里能长期住人哦……
say:1:1035241001:0.male: We can't live inside this old, worn-out tent any longer...
say:1:1035241001:0.female: We can't live inside this old, worn-out tent any longer...

say:2:1035241002:0.text: With the golems going around causing harm, we had no choice but to hide here with our daughter and her child.
say:2:1035241002:0.source_cn: 都怪那什么魔偶，到处伤人害人，我们老两口只能带着女儿和...
say:2:1035241002:0.male: With the golems going around causing harm, we had no choice but to hide here with our daughter and her child.
say:2:1035241002:0.female: With the golems going around causing harm, we had no choice but to hide here with our daughter and her child.

say:3:1035241003:0.text: If it weren't for those cursed golems, we'd have never left home.
say:3:1035241003:0.source_cn: 要不是它们啊，我们一直在家呢。
say:3:1035241003:0.male: If it weren't for those cursed golems, we'd have never left home.
say:3:1035241003:0.female: If it weren't for those cursed golems, we'd have never left home.
